reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and urges viewers to buy paid packages to obtain bonuses and profit. It presents earnings tied to sponsoring people, building a sales team, and receiving commissions across multiple generations, while also promising token appreciation and millionaire-making educational packages. These are direct participation and recruitment claims, not a warning or neutral description.

citations.quote: The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team.
you can earn up to generations of matching bonus
as the one tokens increase in price on our exchange, you will profit
all our packages Include excellent educational material from one academy learn how to trade for profit
do you want to become the next cryptocurrency millionaire

opening.argument: The presentation describes a conditional commercial opportunity, not an unconditional return: bonuses depend on package and status, and earning bonuses requires purchasing a package. It does not state that a return is guaranteed. Its claims may be ambitious, but the cited material alone does not establish that the offer is deceptive or that a buyer is certain to profit. The distinction matters: a promotional claim about a possible business opportunity is not, by itself, proof of a scam.

citations.quote: if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages.
depending on what package and status you have you can earn up to generations of matching bonus

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats sales-team bonuses and token appreciation as proof of a scam, but those statements establish what the promotion claims, not whether the claims are false or whether participants are guaranteed to lose money. The video also specifies that bonuses require a package purchase and depend on status. That qualification does not prove the offer is safe, but it makes the prosecution's certainty stronger than the cited excerpts warrant.

citations.quote: if you would like to profit and earn any bonuses you have to purchase any of our five product packages.
depending on what package and status you have

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the offer conditional does not neutralize the recruitment structure: participants are told to build a team, and their bonuses are tied to its sales volume and generations. Nor does the absence of an express guarantee erase the confident profit and token-appreciation pitch. The cited terms show paid entry and team-based earnings, not merely a conventional sale with an incidental referral reward.

citations.quote: The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team.
you can earn up to generations of matching bonus

opening.argument: A substantial part of the presentation is framed around instruction: the One Academy offers materials on cryptocurrency, trading, and investing, with a step-by-step learning program. The available excerpts describe lessons and educational packages, not a completed trade or a demonstrated payout. The business claims should be assessed critically, but the presence of promotional language does not make the instructional content itself proof of deception; the evidence also supports reading this as a presentation of a proposed learning program and its associated benefits.

citations.quote: Through our ONE Academy with its innovative approach in usability this can be the next bitcoin through our one academy you will learn how to trade in profit from cryptor currency

rebuttal.rebuttal: The Academy material is not presented in isolation as neutral instruction. The opening identifies paid packages, profit-oriented education, and compensation for building a sales team. Calling the material educational does not answer those specific claims; the supplied excerpts connect the instruction to a paid membership and a bonus program.

citations.quote: all our packages Include excellent educational material from one academy learn how to trade for profit
keep your momentum and build your team because the clock is ticking.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The Academy is explicitly described as a way to learn to trade for profit and is bundled with free tokens in paid product packages. The instructional framing therefore does not separate the material from the commercial offer: the video uses education to promote participation and earnings, alongside team bonuses and token claims.

citations.quote: all our packages Include excellent educational material from one academy learn how to trade for profit
All education packages contain free one tokens.

opening.argument: The video does describe a paid package menu and several promotional benefits, including educational materials, tokens, points, and rewards. But its excerpts do not show a completed purchase, an actual payout, or a participant losing money. The pricing passage is also garbled, so it cannot reliably establish the precise cost of each tier. These gaps do not certify the offer as safe; they do mean the material provided is insufficient by itself to establish that the described promotions are fraudulent rather than a conditional membership and rewards program.

citations.quote: Tycoon costs €5000. Executive Trader costs €3000. Pro trader costs €1000. Trader costs €3000 pro trader costs €1000 Traders costs €500 In our starter is €100
Points can be redeemed for items such as holidays, luxury items and exclusive rewards.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening points to explicit package costs and a menu of profit bonuses, including earnings tied to a sales team and matching generations. The fact that the excerpts do not show a completed payout or a victim does not answer whether the promotion itself solicits participation through those mechanisms. The inconsistent price wording warrants caution about exact amounts, not dismissal of the paid-package and team-bonus claims.

citations.quote: The network bonus is accumulated on the weaker side of your sales team.
you can earn up to generations of matching bonus

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A missing depiction of a buyer or payout is not exculpatory when the video itself sets out the offer: bonuses require package purchases, and earnings are linked to sales-team volume and multiple generations. The unclear price transcription affects exact figures, but not the plainly stated paid entry and recruitment-linked compensation.
